Direct exhaustive multiplication checks n=0,...,5 and centralizer/extremal comparisons independently passed; finite checks are not treated as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The mathematical object is the canonical Coxeter type-A face left regular band. Its per-element centralizer profile is a natural complete commutativity invariant; the strict extremal result identifies which support compositions have greatest and least commutants. Their sum also yields an exact probability law with superfactorial decay. This is substantively more information than the independently pre-existing OEIS count; it is neither an arbitrary slice nor merely a known-table recomputation.
